requirements.evidence: config/services.php:40 reads DISCORD_MENTION_ID into services.discord.mention_id; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:39-50 trims the value and accepts only ^\d{17,20}$; :83-93 appends "\n<@id>" and reserves MaxContentLength - strlen($mention), so the mention survives truncation, while the null/no-mention path returns the original 1800-character content unchanged; .env.example:80, docs/ops/devops.md:63 and docs/ops/logging.md:83 document the variable.

conventions.evidence: Config and docs edits match sibling style (.env.example:80, config/services.php:40, docs/ops/logging.md:83), but the change ships no Pest/PHPUnit test despite the mandatory test-first rule, and CHANGELOG.md was not updated under [Unreleased]; no Actions, migrations or Livewire rules apply to this change.

security.evidence: Only the server-side config value is used (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:39); it is trimmed and validated with ^\d{17,20}$ (:41-43) before interpolation, so @everyone, @here, embedded newlines and extra characters such as "123> \n@everyone" are rejected; existing redaction, JSON payload and soft-fail logging are untouched.

tests.evidence: The whole diff touches only .env.example, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/devops.md and docs/ops/logging.md; there is no tests/** addition, so valid/invalid ids, the empty setting, the webhook no-op and truncation-with-mention are all untested.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses existing formatContent and MaxContentLength (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:83-93), but the validation is a verbose is_string/else/null block (:39-50) and the content is truncated twice (:83 and :89).

readability.evidence: Clear names and small methods consistent with the class, but the comment at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:42 says "Accept integer values as strings" while non-string config values are discarded (:40, :48-49), and $contentWithoutMention at :83 later carries the mention, which is mildly misleading.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: the class logic, one config key, .env.example and the two ops docs named in requirement 6; no unrelated refactors, files or features.

issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit test accompanies the new mention behavior, although the project requires every feature to ship with tests and to cover invalid-id rejection, the null/empty no-mention path and the truncation case where the mention must survive.
The change adds no [Unreleased] entry, while the keep-docs-in-sync convention asks for the changelog to be updated in the same change.

The comment claims integer values are accepted as strings, but the code only accepts is_string values and silently discards an integer config value (:40, :48-49); either accept ints or correct the comment.

The content is truncated to 1800 characters and then truncated again to reserve mention space; slicing directly to MaxContentLength - strlen($mention) when a mention exists would do the same with less work.

review.summary: The change adds services.discord.mention_id/DISCORD_MENTION_ID, validates it as a 17-20 digit snowflake, and appends a mention line while reserving truncation space, with the three required docs updated. It functionally covers the task and is security-conscious, but it ships without any tests (a hard project convention) and without a CHANGELOG entry, so it needs changes before merging.
